prompt:
You receive 2 images. Image 1 is a finished background painting of our point-and-click adventure game: the footpath on the north shore of Vrbicke pleso at Jasna, view across the lake to Chopok, painted in summer 2035. Image 2 is the same painting with coloured boxes that only mark the interactive objects, the exits and the walkable floor, which must all stay exactly where they are. Edit image 1 into the SAME PLACE on 6 February 2035, a clear cold day in deep winter, seen by the SAME CAMERA: keep the exact viewpoint, lens, horizon, perspective and framing, and keep the position, size and outline of every building, wall, door, window, pole, rail, sign, piece of furniture, object and tree trunk. Change only what winter changes, as described below. Keep the painting technique, brushwork, palette handling and level of detail of image 1.

Winter changes:
- Vrbicke pleso is FROZEN. Along both shores and around the reeds the ice lies under smooth snow, but a wide band of
  smooth, dark, glassy clear ice across the middle of the lake (the box labelled 'Hladina plesa' in image 2 (x 620-1140, y 560-680 of the 1920x1080 frame (32-59 % from the left, 52-63 % from the top))) is swept free of snow by the
  wind and still mirrors the white mountain and the dark forest (keep that mirror image clearly readable there). No
  open water, no ducks, no boats.
- The far shore, the meadow on the far side and the low shrubs are deep white snow; the dark spruce forest is loaded
  and dusted with snow.
- Chopok is a deep white winter mountain with rocky outcrops showing through; on its slopes groomed ski pistes
  (smooth white bands between the forest edges) with a few tiny distant skiers; the summit buildings white with snow.
- The reed clumps left and right of the lake are dry golden-brown winter reeds sticking out of the snow, with snow
  caught in them (same position and size).
- The rowan branches at the top left are bare winter twigs with a little snow on them and a few clusters of red
  rowan berries (same branches, no green leaves). The big spruce at the right edge is laden with snow.
- The bench (the box labelled 'Lavička so psom' in image 2 (x 290-570, y 545-717 of the 1920x1080 frame (15-30 % from the left, 50-66 % from the top))) stays exactly where it is with the same shape: a small cap of snow on the backrest top
  and on the seat edge, but the plaque with the lettering painted in image 1 and the white ceramic dog on the backrest
  stay fully visible and unchanged (the dog may have a tiny cap of snow on its head).
- The Atlas sensor on its tripod (the box labelled 'Pasívny stojan pri chodníku' in image 2 (x 1205-1305, y 520-718 of the 1920x1080 frame (63-68 % from the left, 48-66 % from the top))) stays the same: a thin layer of snow on the small solar panel,
  the legs standing in the snow.
- The wooden trail post (the box labelled 'Turistické značenie' in image 2 (x 1490-1585, y 405-580 of the 1920x1080 frame (78-83 % from the left, 38-54 % from the top))) stays the same with the blank yellow arrow board and the white-red-white
  hiking mark clearly visible; a small cap of snow on its top and on the arrow board.
- Sky: clear deep winter blue, one or two small clouds; low sun from the left; sparkle on the snow.

Walkable floor: the band at x 0-1920, y 716-1015 of the 1920x1080 frame (0-100 % from the left, 66-94 % from the top) is the lakeside footpath and the low meadow in front, now under snow: the path is a trodden,
packed snow path with footprints, the meadow in front is smooth even snow with a few dry grass stalks and seed heads
poking out - ONE continuous, flat, open surface with no banks, drifts, logs or stones in it. The exit
the box labelled 'exit: Pred hotelom Grand Jasná' in image 2 (x 0-60, y 735-1015 of the 1920x1080 frame (0-3 % from the left, 68-94 % from the top)) is the path leaving at the left edge.
This room has no NPC zones.

Fiction rules: no new lettering, no logos, no people except a few tiny distant skiers on the far slopes, no animals.

Image 2 is a positioning aid only: do NOT draw any of its boxes, outlines, labels or captions. The result is image 1 edited, in the same 16:9 framing: no frames, no borders, no UI, no captions, no watermark, no text except the lettering already in image 1, and no people or animals unless stated above.

Lighting: a clear, cold, sunny winter day in the Low Tatras mountains: deep clean blue sky, low winter sun, crisp blue-violet shadows on the snow, sparkle on fresh snow, cold bright air. The brushwork, line quality and palette harmony stay exactly those of image 1 (style A).

Style: classic 1990s hand-painted adventure game background. Rich painterly brushwork, slightly exaggerated cartoon proportions with gently curved lines, warm late-afternoon sunlight, saturated but harmonious colours, soft dappled shadows under the trees.
